scope: Opt-in native guest-output aggregate tracing; no renderer fix
privacy: Readback pixel arrays remain within the target process; only 32 aggregate tile rows per frame and one worst-change coordinate/value per tile are persisted. No image or desktop capture.

thresholds.black_isolated_pulse: baseline >=31/1023, current <=10/1023 and current <=15% of baseline
thresholds.pulse_baseline: minimum of preceding and following frame values at the same pixel; missing frames reset history
